title: Senior AI Engineer (Python / Node.js)
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior AI Engineer with 5+ years of software and AI/ML engineering experience. Candidates must have a strong background in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java expertise, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will be at the heart of the client's product innovation, responsible for designing, implementing, and operationalizing AI-native services that transform the utility sector. This role combines applied AI/ML expertise with strong back-end engineering skills, ensuring the client's agentic systems are not only functional but scalable, secure, and production-ready.

As a key member of our engineering team, you will report directly to the CTO and operate within small, agile teams alongside software engineers, security experts, and product managers. You will own the full lifecycle of AI services from data ingestion and model training to real-time deployment and monitoring while continuously adapting to evolving requirements in a fast-moving, high-stakes industry.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.


Responsibilities

  • AI Systems Development : Architect, fine-tune, and deploy AI agents purpose-built for utility use cases, including predictive operations, customer engagement, and energy optimization

  • Pipeline Ownership : Design and manage the complete AI pipeline ingestion, embeddings, retrieval, evaluation, and continuous deployment, ensuring reliability and scalability
  • AI Risk Mitigation : Address vulnerabilities unique to AI, such as model drift, bias exploitation, adversarial robustness, and hallucination control with sensitivity to regulated environments
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration : Partner with software engineers, data specialists, and security teams to integrate AI capabilities into the broader client OS, embedding AI by design into every product release
  • Speed of Delivery : Operate with urgency, delivering breakthroughs in code and AI services on cycles measured in weeks, not quarters.


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of applied ML/AI engineering experience, ideally with exposure to enterprise/mission-critical systems.
  • Strong proficiency in Python and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Expertise with ML/LLM frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, LangChain, or equivalent
  • Experience with vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and modern MLOps practices.
  • Track record of deploying AI services in production

  • Analytical, collaborative, and comfortable with ambiguity.
  • Ability to thrive in small, high-velocity teams, balancing experimentation with production rigor


Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience

title: Technical Support Engineer (Tier 2)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Technical Support Engineer with 2+ years of software support experience to join our U.S. client's customer support team. In this role, you will provide daily technical support, assisting customers in resolving their software and compliance-related issues. You will work closely with the Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and Product teams, and you will have access to tool subscriptions, such as Enterprise ChatGPT, Grammarly, and GitHub Copilot (if required), to deliver exceptional support.

Our client makes trust-building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The client's software platform enables companies to quickly and cost-effectively adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure their efficacy against compliance standards, and share achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simple to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable, allowing businesses to gain transparency into their compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Drive resolution of customer issues, act as a customer advocate, and maintain happy and satisfied customers
  • Follow the client's customer support process and meet established service level agreements (SLAs)
  • Triage support requests by conducting a first-level investigation of technical product issues
  • Provide continuous and timely updates on issue resolution status to customers and key internal stakeholders
  • Engage with the Engineering team to ensure timely resolution of customer issues according to SLAs and escalate when necessary to meet those goals


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • University degree with a major in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field
  • 2+ years of customer support experience for a commercial software product
  • Passion for providing technical support to customers and helping them gain success using client products
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate and troubleshoot product issues by reproducing the problem, examining application logs, and reviewing debug messages and stack traces
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities in a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) application environment
  • First point of customer contact and an ability to act independently, as well as a willingness to involve a manager and others when in need of assistance
  • A quick learner who is inquisitive about new products and features
  • Career-minded and willing to take on the responsibilities of learning new software development languages and tools while still maintaining an exceptionally high standard of support delivery
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Demonstrated capabilities using the Chrome Browser Development Toolset when appropriate to solve specific problems
  • Experience with Atlassian/Jira
  • Experience with Linux commands and networking will be a significant advantage
  • Other skills that will help the candidate stand out are as follows:
  • REST APIs (in Postman)
  • JavaScript basics (any programming language)
  • Basic SQL commands
  • Log aggregation and monitoring tools, such as DataDog
  • Experience using project management tools, such as Jira


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

The client's values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.

  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders, proving we are dependable
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team
  • Respect : We are passionate about being respectful and courteous. There's no excuse for being a jerk
  • Evidence-Based Decisions: Our strategy and operations are driven by evidence, which we collect from our customers, product, team, and partners
  • Accountability : We are fanatical about transparency and hold ourselves accountable for everything we do
  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger

The client celebrates diversity. Joyfully building a product that everyone loves requires a team with different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. It is why they are committed to bringing people on board from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Software Engineer
description:
About Us


Vendry is a platform revolutionizing the way companies find, vet, and hire top-performing marketing, web development, and design agencies. By combining cutting-edge technology with human expertise, we streamline the agency search process—delivering tailored solutions that meet each client’s unique needs.


We’re building the infrastructure that powers smarter agency discovery, matchmaking, and evaluation—and we’re looking for a developer who wants real ownership over how that system is built and evolves.


⸻


The Role


As Vendry’s Developer, you’ll be responsible for building, maintaining, and evolving the core technical infrastructure that powers the Vendry platform. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership across frontend, backend, and internal tooling.


You’ll manage everything from our public-facing website and landing pages to our agency portal and proprietary agency search engine. You’ll work closely with the founding team to ship features quickly, improve performance and reliability, and help shape the technical direction of the product.


This is an ideal role for a developer who thrives in early-stage environments, enjoys autonomy, and is excited to build and iterate fast.


⸻


Responsibilities

• Own and manage Vendry’s full technical stack, including:

• Frontend website and marketing landing pages

• Agency portal and internal tools

• Proprietary agency search and matchmaking engine

• Build, ship, and maintain new features across the product with a focus on speed, quality, and scalability.

• Ensure the platform is reliable, performant, and secure as usage grows.

• Collaborate closely with product, operations, and leadership to translate business needs into technical solutions.

• Stay up to date on modern development trends, tools, and best practices.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve velocity and code quality.

• Troubleshoot issues across the stack and proactively improve system architecture.

• Document technical decisions and maintain clean, readable codebases.


⸻


Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience as a software developer or engineer.

• Experience working in a startup environment is a must.

• Strong experience with modern frontend and backend development.

• Comfortable owning projects end-to-end, from idea to production.

• Familiarity with databases, APIs, and search or filtering systems is a plus.

• Experience building or maintaining SaaS products or internal platforms is strongly preferred.

• Curious, self-motivated, and comfortable working independently in a remote environment.

• Strong problem-solving skills and clear written communication.


⸻


Compensation

• Salary: $2,000–$4,000 USD per month, depending on experience and scope.

• Full-time, remote role.


⸻


Why Join Vendry


Joining Vendry means having real ownership over a product that’s redefining how brands find agency partners. You won’t be maintaining a tiny slice of a massive codebase—you’ll be shaping the foundation of a growing platform.


  • We’re a small, fast-moving team that values initiative, clarity of thinking, and building practical solutions that actually get used. If you enjoy shipping, iterating, and seeing your work directly impact the business, you’ll feel right at home.

title: Senior Full Stack AI Engineer
description:
About Us

Founded in 2019 by two best friends, Jon and Eli, XILO set out to revolutionize the insurance industry by solving its biggest challenges. Eli, a brokerage owner, brought invaluable industry expertise, while Jon, an experienced software engineer, saw an opportunity to innovate using technology.

Initially launched as a vertical SaaS solution addressing core quoting challenges, XILO has since evolved into a trailblazing Vertical AI company leveraging the latest AI technology to transform the industry. By layering cutting-edge AI solutions onto its SaaS platform, XILO is driving innovation far beyond its original vision. Having recently closed our Series A funding round, XILO is growing rapidly and seeking talented individuals who want to do career-defining work in a mission-driven startup that’s at the forefront of AI innovation.


The Mission

We are looking for a Senior Engineer to replace a key member of our technical team. You will be joining a group working on a revolutionary product designed to completely transform the United States Insurance Industry. This is not just a standard CRUD application; we are building complex workflows involving AI agents and browser-based tooling to modernize a legacy industry.


The Role

You will act as a Full Stack Developer with a heavy emphasis on Backend and AI logic. While Python is your primary weapon for new development, you must be versatile enough to tune existing Node.js services and handle frontend requirements in Angular and Chrome Extensions.

We are looking for someone who understands Agentic Workflows —how to organize AI models to perform complex tasks—not just someone who knows how to make a simple API call to OpenAI.


Key Responsibilities

  • AI & Backend Architecture: Design and implement robust backend services using Python. You will lead the development of AI Agents, defining how they interact, manage context, and execute tasks.
  • Browser-Based Innovation : Maintain and expand our core Chrome Extension product. This is a critical interface for our users.
  • Service Tuning: Interface with and optimize existing microservices written in Node.js . You don’t need to be a Node expert, but you must be comfortable reading, debugging, and tuning this code.
  • Frontend Maintenance: implement UI/UX features using Angular . While the role is backend-heavy, you should be comfortable jumping into the frontend to ship complete features.
  • Light Infrastructure: Handle very basic deployment or configuration tasks (DevOps is not a primary duty, but “infrastructure awareness” is required).


What we’re looking for

  • Seniority: 5+ years of commercial software development experience.
  • Python Mastery: Deep experience with Python for backend development.
  • AI/Agent Experience: proven experience working with LLMs and AI Agents. You understand the architecture of agentic frameworks (loops, memory, tools).
  • Note: Specific framework knowledge (LangChain, CrewAI) is a plus, but a strong conceptual grasp of how agents are organized is mandatory.
  • Node.js Proficiency: Ability to read, understand, and patch Node.js environments.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with LangChain or CrewAI .
  • Experience building or maintaining complex browser extensions (manifest v3, background scripts, content injection).
  • Previous experience in the InsurTech or Fintech sectors.
  • Background in modernizing legacy workflows with automation.
  • Familiarity with Angular .


Why Join Us?

  • Impact: Work on a product that is actively changing how the US insurance market operates.
  • Cutting Edge Tech: We are not just talking about AI; we are implementing agentic workflows in production.
  • Remote Culture: Work from anywhere with a team that values output over hours.

title: DevOps Pleno - GCP
description:
Quem somos nós?

Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT

  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um/uma DevOps para fazer parte de nosso movimento. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por gerenciar o ciclo de vida completo de aplicações, desde o desenvolvimento até a entrega em produção, garantindo eficiência e agilidade por meio da automação e de metodologias ágeis.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?

  • Gerenciar e manter ambientes em cloud (GCP) , garantindo escalabilidade, segurança e eficiência.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de infraestrutura como código (IaC) utilizando Terraform .
  • Desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD em GitLab , automatizando todo o ciclo de entrega.
  • Aplicar práticas de GitOps com Argo CD , assegurando a automação e consistência das implantações.
  • Administrar e evoluir ambientes Kubernetes , monitorando performance, consumo e segurança dos clusters.
  • Criar e manter scripts de automação para tarefas rotineiras, integrações e melhorias de processos.
  • Configurar e monitorar ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace , garantindo visibilidade e resposta rápida a incidentes.
  • Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento e produto para garantir entregas rápidas, seguras e de alta qualidade.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos e da arquitetura de infraestrutura.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:

  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Kubernetes , com experiência na administração de clusters, deploys (Helm/Manifests), configuração de RBAC, network policies e troubleshooting em produção.
  • Experiência com GitOps utilizando Argo CD , incluindo implementação e manutenção de pipelines, gestão de sincronização de aplicações e rollback automatizado.
  • Experiência com GitLab , aplicando CI/CD para pipelines complexos, runners, templates e integração com ambientes cloud.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em GCP , com vivência prática em serviços como Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Cloud Storage, IAM, VPC, autoscaling e otimização de custos.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em Terraform , incluindo desenvolvimento e manutenção de módulos reutilizáveis, gerenciamento de estado remoto e versionamento de infraestrutura.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Datadog, New Relic ou Dynatrace, configurando métricas, alertas, dashboards e tracing.
  • Experiência com scripting e automação , utilizando Python, Bash ou Go para automação de operações, criação de pipelines e integrações.
  • Vivência prática com CI/CD , desenhando, implementando e otimizando pipelines de integração e entrega contínua, com testes automatizados e estratégias de rollout (canary, blue/green).
  • Conhecimento em práticas de segurança em cloud e containers , incluindo hardening de clusters, gestão de segredos, políticas de acesso e scanners de vulnerabilidade.


Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com Oracle Cloud (OCI).


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

description:

  • Vivência com infraestrutura em nuvem (preferencialmente GCP), automação de infraestrutura (IaC), CI/CD e observabilidade;

Diferenciais:

title: Store Manager (Gerente de Loja)
description:

O dia a dia na H&M


Vendas & Receita

  • Responsável pela experiência omnicanal total do cliente na sua loja, garantindo curadoria visual e comercial de acordo com o formato da sua loja, diretrizes globais e estratégias regionais.
  • Representar positivamente a si mesmo e a marca H&M durante todas as interações com os clientes.
  • Estabelecer, analisar e acompanhar as metas de vendas e orçamento, criando planos para otimizar os resultados.
  • Garantir que o serviço personalizado ao cliente seja fornecido em todas as áreas da loja, assegurando que sua equipe inicie interações com os clientes, guiando-os através das histórias da moda e trabalhando ativamente na venda de nossos produtos.
  • Acompanhar sua equipe para garantir que esteja promovendo ativamente nosso aplicativo de fidelidade do cliente (Hello Member) e iniciativas de sustentabilidade na loja.
  • Definir o plano de horas e agendamento alinhados com o orçamento de vendas e atividades comerciais.
  • Garantir que as rotinas corretas sejam seguidas nos provadores e no checkout, incluindo transações, devoluções e trocas.
  • Estar ciente dos pontos fortes e oportunidades da sua loja, identificando oportunidades comerciais e agindo sobre elas. Ter conhecimento da concorrência.
  • Gerenciar a manutenção da loja de forma eficiente em termos de custo.
  • Garantir que todas as rotinas administrativas tanto para pessoas quanto para operações sejam tratadas de maneira correta.


Moda & Tendências

  • Manter-se atualizado com o cenário da moda, tendências, estilos, marcas, concorrentes e influenciadores relevantes, etc.
  • Garantir que sua equipe forneça conhecimento sobre produtos e moda, além de outras informações relevantes durante as interações com os clientes.
  • Assegurar-se de que haja uma boa compreensão da área local da sua loja, dos clientes, da concorrência e das tendências de moda.


Equipe & Desenvolvimento

  • Responsável pela gestão de talentos na sua loja – recrutamento, integração, aprimoramento e desenvolvimento da sua equipe.
  • Realizar avaliações de desempenho e planejamento de sucessão para apoiar as necessidades do negócio e da equipe.
  • Reter e compartilhar seu conhecimento e habilidades com sua equipe.
  • Forte colaboração com a equipe da Área e a equipe de liderança da loja, incluindo VM (Visual Merchandisers).
  • Garantir excelente comunicação e profissionalismo com parceiros externos.
  • Responsável pelo planejamento e agendamento da equipe.
  • Comunicação regular com os colaboradores de loja para informar, motivar e inspirar – reuniões diárias/semanalmente, etc.
  • Garantir que todos os procedimentos, rotinas, requisitos de segurança e legais em todas as áreas da loja sejam seguidos.
  • Participar dos processos relevantes de Integração e Introdução disponíveis, Treinamentos e Cursos relevantes para seu cargo e desenvolvimento futuro.


Operações de Varejo/Execução Visual e Comercial

  • Garantir um piso de vendas limpo e organizado e a área de apoio (back of house).
  • Garantir alta qualidade de moda, apresentação visual e comercial dos produtos, com excelente cuidado com as roupas.
  • Garantir bons níveis de estoque e fornecer sugestões sobre a alocação para a área relevante ou colegas do mercado de vendas.
  • Responsável e dá apoio nas rotinas diárias de abertura e fechamento da loja e processos.
  • Garantir todo o ciclo da peça de roupa – desde a entrega até a apresentação da peça – e as rotinas do provador, de acordo com nossos padrões, processos, utilizando todas as ferramentas e tecnologias fornecidas.
  • Manter e seguir as melhores práticas para qualquer serviço OMNI dentro da loja e serviços/ferramentas tecnológicas da loja (Instore Care App, Click & Collect, Smart Store, etc).
  • Garantir um forte equilíbrio e a manutenção de sinalizações de preços dentro da loja e ao longo do piso de vendas/loja, seguindo as diretrizes de acordo com as estratégias globais e locais e os requisitos do mercado/região de vendas para garantir uma percepção de preço forte e consistente em toda a loja.
  • Atualização e manutenção das áreas de BOH (back of house) para todos os colaboradores (informações-chave, saúde e segurança, organização, etc).

Qualificações


Quem você é

  • Você será um(a) líder comprometido que gosta de assumir responsabilidades.
  • É confiante no treinamento e desenvolvimento da equipe. Você deve ser ambicioso(a), um(a) comunicador(a) eficaz, um(a) solucionador(a) analítico(a) de problemas, capaz de trabalhar e gerenciar os números.
  • Você é orientado para resultados, motivado(a) por desempenho e competição.
  • Possui habilidades em apresentação visual e comercial, além de ter uma forte compreensão e interesse por tendências de moda, comercialização e concorrentes.

Porque você adorará trabalhar na H&M

  • Valorizamos a diversidade em todos os seus âmbitos, incluindo, mas não se limitando a raça, etnia, gênero, idade, religião, orientação sexual e deficiência.
  • Nos orgulhamos de ser uma organização orientada por valores, guiada pelos nossos 7 valores únicos, que fazem parte da nossa história de sucesso há mais de 75 anos.
  • Você terá acesso aos nossos Grupos de Recursos para Colaboradores (CRGs) para encontrar oportunidades de comunidade e networking entre os(as) colaboradores(as). Somos uma empresa inclusiva onde você é incentivado a ser você mesmo no trabalho.
  • Você terá acesso a uma grande comunidade global de talentos, na qual o crescimento de carreira e as aspirações não têm limites.
  • Você poderá expressar seu estilo pessoal com nosso desconto para colaboradores(as) na H&M.


Inclusão e Diversidade

A H&M faz parte do Grupo H&M. No Grupo H&M, estamos determinados a criar e manter ambientes de trabalho inclusivos, diversos e justos em toda a nossa organização. Ter uma força de trabalho diversificada gera um impacto positivo sobre como enfrentamos desafios, o que percebemos como possível e como escolhemos nos relacionar com nossos colaboradores e clientes ao redor do mundo. Buscamos ter um processo justo e igualitário e, por isso, pedimos, por favor, que você não anexe uma carta de apresentação em sua candidatura, pois muitas vezes elas contêm informações que podem gerar vieses inconscientes.

Na H&M, nosso propósito é gerar a moda para todos. Queremos moldar um novo mundo na moda. Um mundo com um único objetivo: liberar a sua autoexpressão. Você assumirá novas responsabilidades desde o primeiro dia, aprenderá habilidades para a vida e encontrará novas formas de fazer seus grandes sonhos se tornarem realidade.


Nossa empresa está comprometida em fomentar uma cultura de inclusão e pertencimento, e buscamos ativamente colaboradores(as) que compartilhem nosso compromisso.

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 60 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de soluções de staffing, soluções de TI e complementação de força de trabalho. Estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, projetos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação. Apoiamos nossos clientes para encontrar a melhor maneira que seu gap de talentos seja endereçado, de maneira a suportar seu processo de transformação digital. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós


Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. A Dexian está comprometida com a responsabilidade social corporativa e, investe em programas que apoiam a diversidade e inclusão.

Se você compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar!

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho


Desenvolver, treinar e otimizar modelos de Machine Learning para resolver problemas de negócio, utilizando linguagens como Python ou R.

Realizar modelagem de dados, estruturando e preparando bases de dados para análises avançadas e para consumo por modelos estatísticos e preditivos.

Extrair, manipular e analisar dados utilizando SQL, garantindo qualidade, consistência e performance nas consultas.

Avaliar, validar e monitorar o desempenho dos modelos em produção, aplicando métricas estatísticas e ajustes contínuos para melhoria de resultados.

Colaborar com times multidisciplinares para traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções analíticas, documentando processos, hipóteses e resultados de forma clara e acessível.

No conforto da sua casa, regime 100% remoto!

title: Data Engineer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About your Team

At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.

Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.


The Impact You'll Make

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
  • Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
  • Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
  • Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.


About You

  • 2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
  • Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
  • Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
  • Hands-on experience with data lake technologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
  • Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
  • Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
  • Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., CloudWatch, New Relic, PagerDuty)
  • Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaboration


  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform )
  • Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using Airflow and Spark


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s data team based in the United States and Hotmart’s data team in Brazil.

title: Senior Recruiter/Headhunter
description:
The role

Adsora is a performance marketing company focused on affiliate offers. We are hiring a senior recruiter who can run end-to-end hiring for high-impact roles, starting with a senior Meta media buyer who has recently scaled affiliate offers from $5k to $100k per day on Meta (proof required). Experience across YouTube, TikTok, and native is a plus.


This is not a “post a job and wait” role. You will hunt, qualify, and close talent. You will also own a set of VA-style support tasks that keep the hiring machine and daily ops moving.

We currently manage about $500k per month in Meta spend and we want to scale faster with A-level operators.


Mission

Build and run a predictable hiring pipeline that consistently lands operators who can scale paid social profitably, starting with a senior Meta affiliate media buyer.


What success looks like First 30 days
  • Fill the senior Meta buyer role (or have multiple final-stage candidates ready).
  • Build a clear scorecard and interview plan for the senior Meta buyer role (and next roles in the queue).
  • Launch outbound sourcing across multiple channels (LinkedIn, communities, referrals, databases, etc.).
  • Deliver a steady flow of qualified candidates each week (not just resumes).
  • Run structured screens that filter for real affiliate scaling experience, proof, and owner mindset.
  • Set up a clean tracking system for the pipeline (stages, notes, next steps, rejection reasons).

    • By 90 days
    • Fill 2-8 roles.


    By 12 months
    • Own recruiting as a system: documented sourcing playbooks, question banks, scorecards, and evaluation rubrics.
    • Consistently fill priority roles fast with high retention and high output hires.
    • Be the internal “talent operator” who can scale the team as spend scales.


    Responsibilities Recruiting and interviewing
    • Own the full recruiting cycle: sourcing, outreach, screening, interview coordination, follow-ups, references, offers.
    • Write and post job listings, then actively recruit instead of waiting for applicants.
    • Run structured screens focused on proof, recent performance, decision quality, and ownership.
    • Coordinate skills tests and case studies (and keep candidates moving quickly).
    • Build candidate packets for the hiring manager: summary, proof, strengths/risks, compensation expectations, notes.
    • Keep the process tight: fast response times, clean communication, no dropped balls.
    “Proof-first” candidate validation
    • Validate recent spend, results, and context (offer type, tracking, payout structure, constraints).
    • Spot inflated claims and surface the real story behind performance screenshots.
    • Ask the questions that reveal if someone can truly scale, not just maintain.
    VA and ops support (light but important)
    • Calendar management for interviews and internal meetings.
    • Inbox support for hiring related messages and candidate follow-ups.
    • Basic research tasks (talent lists, role benchmarks, competitor hiring patterns, community sourcing).
    • Keep docs organized (scorecards, interview notes, pipelines, templates, candidate folders).


    Who you are
    • You have recruited for performance marketing roles before (media buyers, affiliate marketers, creative, editors, tracking/ops).
    • You understand the language of direct response: CPA, CPL, EPC, payouts, margins, tracking, attribution, postbacks.
    • You can confidently screen a “senior Meta buyer” and know what real proof looks like.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Quem Somos

A PayConductor.AI está construindo a plataforma de orquestração de pagamentos mais inteligente do mundo. Não somos apenas mais uma fintech, estamos desenvolvendo uma frota de agentes de IA especializados que otimizam rotas de pagamento, reduzem custos e transformam dados financeiros complexos em insights acionáveis em tempo real.

Acreditamos que pagamentos devem ser inteligentes, fluidos e auto-otimizáveis. Nosso time é enxuto, rápido e obcecado em construir tecnologia que realmente funciona.

Se você quer fazer parte de algo que ainda não existe em nenhum outro lugar, seja bem-vindo.


Descrição

Dados são o novo petróleo. Só que petróleo não precisa ser limpo, transformado, versionado e disponibilizado em tempo real para uma frota de agentes de IA famintos por informação. Dados precisam. E é aí que você entra.

Na PayConductor, estamos construindo a infraestrutura de dados que vai alimentar a próxima geração de inteligência em pagamentos. Não estamos falando de dashboardzinhos bonitos, estamos falando de pipelines robustos que ingerem dados de adquirentes, bandeiras, Banco Central, e transformam tudo isso em combustível para IAs que tomam decisões em milissegundos.

Se você acha que um pipeline bem arquitetado é uma obra de arte, que data quality é questão de honra, e que \"funciona na minha máquina\" não é resposta aceitável, vem com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados escaláveis para ingestão de múltiplas fontes (APIs de adquirentes, arquivos de bandeiras, dados regulatórios).
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e governança dos dados que alimentam os agentes de IA.
  • Construir data lakes e data warehouses que façam sentido (não aquele cemitério de tabelas que ninguém entende).
  • Implementar processos de ETL/ELT eficientes e monitoráveis.
  • Colaborar com o time de ML para garantir que os dados estejam no formato certo, na hora certa, no lugar certo.
  • Documentar schemas, linhagem de dados e processos como se o próximo engenheiro fosse um serial killer que sabe seu endereço.


Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida com Python e SQL (SQL de verdade, não só SELECT *).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e seus serviços de dados.
  • Familiaridade com bancos relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Entendimento de princípios de data quality e data governance.
  • Capacidade de debugar um pipeline às 23h sem chorar (muito).
  • Diferenciais: experiência com dados financeiros/transacionais, conhecimento de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis), familiaridade com o ecossistema de pagamentos mundial.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.

Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

We are seeking a Junior Recruitment Analyst to deliver "white glove," concierge-level recruitment service for our esteemed pharmaceutical client, focusing on the Brazilian market. This role demands an individual who is polished in nature, process-driven, and possesses a strong service mindset with superior communication skills and a keen attention to detail.

  • Experience: A minimum of 1+ year in a role directly supporting recruiting functions and demonstrated full-cycle recruiting experience for at least one year.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or currently enrolled to obtain one.

  • Languages: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is required for sourcing within Brazil and collaborating with international stakeholders. Spanish is a plus.
  • Systems: Demonstrated Applicant Tracking System (ATS) experience and a solid understanding of MS Office/Google products.
  • Mindset: Proven ability to work within a team environment, take direction and execute a plan, and possess a strong detail orientation with follow-through shown in previous jobs.

What's In It For You

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.
Qualifications
Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
Some experience with MPI programming.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio

title: Network Engineer Commissioning Specialist (BSC/RNC), OSS and Sites
description:
We are looking for a Wireless Specialist with solid experience in mobile networks, responsible for commissioning, integration, and validation of Controllers (BSC/RNC), as well as operation and management of OSS platforms and support for field activities related to telecommunications sites.
This professional will work directly throughout the deployment, expansion, and optimization cycle of the network, ensuring performance, availability, and compliance with the client's technical requirements.

(Must-have).
Perform commissioning, integration, testing, and troubleshooting of 2G/3G/4G/5G, Controllers (BSC/RNC) and OSS.

Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2G/3G/4G/5G networks.
Solid knowledge of RF, parameters, handovers, features, and network architecture.
Ability to interpret logs, KPIs, and performance reports.
Experience with integration scripts (MML, CLI, or equivalent).
Desirable experience with O&M interfaces and network databases.
Knowledge of field processes: Survey, Swap, and site activation.
Desired Profile:
Analytical, organized, and strong problem-solving skills.
Clear and objective communication with clients and internal teams.
Ability to work under pressure and during critical maintenance windows.
Proactive and collaborative attitude.
Education:
Bachelor's degree in Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
Certifications or training related to mobile networks will be considered an advantage.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.
Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.
Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.
Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):
Operational Leadership
Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.
Team Development
Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.
Compliance & QHSE
Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.
Commercial
Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.
Team Culture and Engagement
Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.
Client Account Management
Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.
Coordination Responsibilities
Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.
Qualifications and Skills
Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.
Personal Attributes
Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.
Additional Information:
This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.
Travel
Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.
HSE Awareness:
All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.
Why Join Us?
This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.
We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.
Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.
Apply now
and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
About You
You are a Senior Data Engineer who enjoys building reliable, scalable data platforms and enabling data-driven and AI-powered products. You feel comfortable owning data pipelines end to end, working closely with analytics and AI/Data Science teams, and translating complex data problems into robust technical solutions.
You value clean architecture, performance, and data quality, and you're curious about AI/ML integrations even if you're not a model builder. You thrive in collaborative environments and can operate with autonomy while guiding best practices across teams.
You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:
Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field — or equivalent professional experience.
5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer, building and operating production-grade data pipelines.
Strong expertise in SQL, including advanced joins, CTEs, window functions, and performance tuning.
Experience designing data models and analytical structures (dimensional models, facts, dimensions, SCDs).
Hands-on experience building ETL/ELT pipelines using modern orchestration tools (Airflow, Dagster, DBT, or similar).
Proficiency in Python for data processing and pipeline development (PySpark is a strong plus).
Solid experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) for data storage and processing.
Familiarity with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, PostgreSQL, or similar.
Experience using Git and CI/CD practices as part of a modern data engineering workflow.
Exposure to supporting AI/Data Science initiatives, such as data enablement for models, embeddings, entity matching, or advanced analytics (nice to have).
Familiarity with graph databases, embeddings, or AI integrations from a data engineering perspective (nice to have).
Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with analysts, ML engineers, and product teams.
Advanced English proficiency (B2+), able to work with global stakeholders.
You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ingestion processes supporting analytics and AI use cases.
Implement and optimize ETL/ELT workflows with attention to performance, reliability, and cost.
Design and evolve data models and curated layers to support reporting, analytics, and downstream systems.
Collaborate with analytics, AI/Data Science, and product teams to understand data requirements and SLAs.
Support AI and advanced analytics features by providing clean, well-structured, and reliable datasets.
Apply best practices around data quality, validation, monitoring, and observability.
Write maintainable, well-documented data code and contribute to shared standards and patterns.
Participate in architecture discussions and help improve overall data platform design.
(If senior/lead-leaning) Support or mentor less-experienced data engineers as the team grows.
Additional Information
Here at Applaudo Studios values as trust, communication, respect, excellence and team work are our keys to success. We know we are working with the best and thus treat each other with respect and admiration without asking.
Submit your application today, and don't miss this opportunity to join the Best Digital team in the Region!
We truly appreciate all the hard and outstanding work our team makes every day at Applaudo Studios, and that's why the perks that we offer, are deeply thought and designed as a way to thank them for their commitment and excellence.
Some of our perks and benefits:
Celebrations

Entertainment area*

Great work environment
Private medical insurance*

title: Supervisor (a) Responsabilidade Social
description:
A Aegea
Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.
Programa Respeito dá o Tom
O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.
Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.
A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.
Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.
Missão do cargo:
Responsável por supervisionar as atividades da área de Responsabilidade Social, garantindo a qualidade dos serviços prestados, o cumprimento da legislação aplicável e a execução dos projetos sociais alinhados ao planejamento estratégico da unidade.
Principais Responsabilidades
Supervisionar as atividades da equipe, assegurando qualidade e desempenho.
Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos e propor planos de ação.
Conduzir interlocução com lideranças comunitárias, garantindo alinhamento com objetivos do projeto.
Garantir a execução das atividades conforme planejamento estratégico da área.
Colaborar na elaboração do planejamento estratégico de Responsabilidade Social.
Controlar o direcionamento da atuação social da unidade conforme objetivos estratégicos.
Supervisionar procedimentos da pasta social do Programa Interage e gestão da legislação aplicável.
Monitorar o cumprimento da legislação de Responsabilidade Social.
Supervisionar a execução de projetos sociais e acompanhar projetos incentivados.
Direcionar atividades de relacionamento com populações em situação de vulnerabilidade.
Participar de processos de recrutamento e seleção da equipe, quando necessário.
Contribuir na definição de programas de treinamento e reciclagem profissional.
Elaborar relatórios gerenciais solicitados pela gerência.
Garantir conservação e limpeza dos equipamentos de trabalho.
Cumprir normas e procedimentos internos.
Conduzir veículos utilizados nas atividades de forma segura.
Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de saúde, segurança e uso adequado de EPIs.
Comprometer-se com as áreas de Gestão da Qualidade, Meio Ambiente e Segurança do Trabalho.
Executar outras tarefas correlatas conforme orientação do superior imediato.
Requisitos
Formação:
Ensino superior completo (preferencialmente em áreas relacionadas à Responsabilidade Social, Administração ou Gestão de Projetos).
Experiência:
Atuação anterior em supervisão de equipes e projetos sociais.
Conhecimentos:
Legislação de Responsabilidade Social, gestão de projetos, planejamento estratégico.
Habilidades:
Liderança, comunicação, organização, tomada de decisão.
Informações adicionais:
Assistência médica;
Assistência odontológica;
Zenklub (atendimento direcionado à saúde mental e nutricional);
Serviço de assistência gratuito (social, jurídico e financeiro);
Seguro de vida;
Vale transporte;
Gympass;
Vale alimentação e/ou refeição;
Participação nos Lucros e Resultados;
Kit office.
Somos um time de Profissionais Além da Conta!
A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +892 municípios em que atuamos. Levamos saúde, qualidade de vida e dignidade para mais de aproximadamente 39 milhões de pessoas de norte a sul do Brasil. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.
Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 22.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Product Owner - Consultor(a) Senior
description:
Descrição do perfil
Responsável por liderar a condução de projetos e iniciativas ágeis de ponta a ponta, desde a definição das histórias e priorização do backlog até o acompanhamento da entrega final, assegurando a qualidade e integridade conceitual das entregas. Atua garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio e técnica para assegurar que as entregas estejam alinhadas ao escopo definido e aos objetivos da empresa. Além disso, mantém as práticas Scrum, apoia os outros papéis e garante comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads, atuando como educador para assegurar o respeito aos valores e metodologia ágil.
Principais atividades
Apoiar a gestão de projetos de lançamento de novas ofertas considerando atividades E2E, desde a solicitação do gerente de produto até o delivery técnico;
Definir a visão do produto, seu roadmap e oportunidades de crescimento com os diversos stakeholders;
Construir escopo junto com Líder de Produto, atuando no processo de elaboração de user stories garantindo requisitos necessários e alinhamento de expectativas junto às áreas de negócio;
Liderar grupos multidisciplinares para garantir a correta especificação do produto, ajudando na análise e negociação de impactos diretamente com as áreas de negócio;
Desafiar as áreas de negócio acerca de features de produtos, processos ou regras;
Traduzir a estratégia de negócios para o time técnico, garantindo o entendimento dos requisitos;
Negociar escopos prioritários com foco na estratégia de negócios, discutindo trade-offs estratégicos;
Validar refinamentos técnicos garantindo aderência ao escopo solicitado;
Conduzir cerimônias ágeis de alta transversalidade (diversas esteiras/sprints de desenvolvimento), centralizando decisões estratégicas;
Elaborar critérios de aceite para garantir alinhamento com demais times envolvidos, assegurando visão única de projeto/produto;
Realizar a validação e aprovação dos testes garantindo a qualidade da entrega e coordenar aprovação dos demais times envolvidos;
Acompanhar entrega e performance dos testes pós-produção para garantir funcionamento e velocidade na correção;
Apontar issues para serem endereçados pelo time técnico identificado;
Controlar cronograma e budget dos projetos garantindo aderência à estratégia;
Manter um olhar atento, crítico e propositivo durante todas as etapas do projeto, utilizando dados, aprendizados e feedbacks para monitorar a aderência ao processo e propor melhorias contínuas de forma assertiva;
Garantir a manutenção das práticas Scrum, apoiar os papéis envolvidos e manter a comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads;
Atuar como educador para assegurar que todos os participantes conheçam e respeitem os princípios e valores do Scrum.
Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Experiência como Product Owner, Project Manager ou Scrum Master com atuação prática em projetos ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de backlog, elaboração de histórias e releases;
  • Capacidade de atuar com diferentes stakeholders e áreas técnicas, negociando escopos e prazos;
  • Habilidade para escrever e organizar user stories, critérios de aceite e planos de entrega;
  • Conhecimento em rituais ágeis e na condução de cerimônias com múltiplas esteiras ou times;
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e com forte senso de responsabilidade pela entrega de valor;
  • Ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Azure, Jira, Monday;
  • Boa capacidade de articulação, visão crítica e habilidade de propor melhorias processuais com base em experiência prática;
  • Inglês avançado é obrigatório;
  • Graduação Completa em Administração/Marketing/Tecnologia/Engenharia.
