Nossa equipe de tecnologia está na vanguarda das soluções digitais, trabalhando com as mais recentes ferramentas e metodologias para oferecer resultados excepcionais aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos com projetos desafiadores que impactam diretamente nossos clientes e a sociedade. Nossa equipe é composta por profissionais altamente qualificados e dedicados, que colaboram para alcançar resultados extraordinários. Estamos em busca de Desenvolvedor React Senior, para nosso escritório do Rio de Janeiro. Se você possui os requisitos e conhecimentos abaixo, essa oportunidade pode ser sua : Participar de todas as fases do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para definir, projetar e entregar novas funcionalidades. Documentar processos e soluções desenvolvidas. Conhecimento Técnico: Proficiência em Java EE ou C#. Proficiência em React. Conhecimento em frameworks como Spring e Hibernate. Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais ( SQL ) e não relacionais ( NoSQL ). Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código ( Git ). Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful. Experiência com testes automatizados ( JUnit, Mockito, Jest ). Requisitos Desejáveis Experiência com metodologias ágeis ( Scrum, Kanban ). Familiaridade com Docker e Kubernetes. Importante residir no Rio de Janeiro : necessidade de presença no escritório ou cliente conforme demanda do projeto. Você está pronto(a) para fazer a diferença? Aqui, você pode crescer de forma real. Nós somos a PwC. Somos visionários. Trabalhamos com tecnologias de ponta, impulsionados pelas nossas pessoas, para entregar valor, gerar impacto e levar nossos clientes à vanguarda. Em tempos de transformação acelerada, utilizamos nossa expertise em indústrias, nossa experiência, competências e serviços integrados para construir confiança e resolver problemas importantes. Somos guiados pelos nossos valores, consistentes em nossa qualidade e dedicados a fazer a diferença. Aqui, seu desenvolvimento e crescimento se tornam uma vantagem para nossos clientes e influenciam o futuro do mundo. Grow here. Go further.

title: Analista De Projetos
description: Sobre a vaga Nosso escritório do Rio de Janeiro busca Analista de Projetos para o Time de TI. Se você tem experiência em ERP, candidate-se a esta oportunidade! Requisitos: Graduação completa em tecnologia, engenharia da computação, sistemas de informação e/ou áreas correlatas. Experiência comprovada em ERP na utilização do Protheus e Legal Desk é imprescindível. Conhecimento em integrações via APIs, web services e arquitetura orientada a serviços. Diferencial: experiência no sistema de faturamento e financeiro do setor jurídico. Principais Responsabilidades: Conhecimento e experiência com ERP, especialmente Totvs e suas integrações entre os módulos de faturamento, financeiro e jurídico. Dar suporte aos usuários em ambiente Totvs (Protheus) e Legal Desk. Atuar como interface entre demandas da Controladoria Jurídica com a TOTVS. Atuar no auxílio a sanitização dos cadastros básicos do sistema, demandas de novos campos, relatórios e etc. Atuar na arquitetura de sistemas, garantindo integração entre plataformas e fornecedores. Conduzir projetos de parametrização, customização e automação de tarefas, bem como a melhoria contínua dos processos internos. Participar de reuniões técnicas e estratégicas, promovendo alinhamento entre áreas e fornecedores de sistemas. Garantir o entendimento sistêmico dos processos do financeiro, faturamento e jurídico. Desenvolver e acompanhar os indicadores de desempenho Realizar documentação e treinamentos referentes aos módulos do Legal Desk para o jurídico. Assegurar conformidade com políticas internas e requisitos legais do sistema. Buscar e avaliar novas tecnologias para o escritório. Informações adicionais: Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio de Janeiro Sobre nós Nossa história começou em 1932 e, desde então, acumulamos vasta experiência na prestação de assessoria jurídica a clientes nacionais e internacionais. Somos um escritório de advocacia full service especializado nos setores de infra-estrutura, comércio e logística com destaque em direito marítimo, portos e infraestrutura, energia, óleo e gás, ambiental, ferroviário e setor público com foco em contencioso e arbitragem, tributário e aduaneiro, societário, regulatório, contratual, trabalhista e compliance, Estamos localizados no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Brasília e Vitória, com atuação em todo território nacional. Nosso propósito no Kincaid é criar uma equipe multidisciplinar, sempre pronta para entregar as melhores soluções jurídicas para os clientes. Investimos nos nossos profissionais e no ambiente de trabalho buscando sempre o desenvolvimento de uma carreira transformadora! No Kincaid respeitamos as individualidades e trabalhamos para promover uma cultura inclusiva, que busca a equidade e valoriza as diferenças. Todas as nossas vagas respeitam esse compromisso! Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Analista Contábil
description:

Tudo isso com a essência da Australidade, que traduz nosso jeito único de fazer acontecer: proximidade, transparência, colaboração e foco em resultados. É assim que transformamos desafios em oportunidades e entregamos valor para todos os nossos parceiros. Conhecimentosatuariais em reservas técnicas, CMR, Ativo Garantidor e TAP;

Ser criativo na resolução de problemas;
Profissional que demonstre interesse em buscar novas atividades e que tenha facilidade para produzir novas ideias.

title: Analista De Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.Responsabilidades e atribuições- Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
- Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
- Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
- Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
- Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
- Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
- Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
- Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
- Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.Requisitos e qualificações- Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
- Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
- Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
- Conhecimento em sistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.Informações adicionaisO Que Temos Para Você- Vale Refeição/Alimentação;
- Vale Transporte/Estacionamento;
- Plano de Saúde;
-Plano Odontológico;

- Bônus anual.Local de Trabalho: Escritórios Corporativos Tijuca e Leblon - RJEscala: 5x2

title: Analista De Pcp Senior
description:
Identificação da Prestação de Serviços Título: Prestador(a) de Serviços em Desenvolvimento de Software (PJ – Nível Inicial) Atuação: Desenvolvimento de software para o AdvSpace Ponto de contato técnico: Breno Andrade Local de prestação: Remoto Modalidade de contratação: Prestação de serviços como Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) Valor: R$ 2.500,00 mensais, mediante emissão de nota fiscal, podendo ser ajustado de acordo com o escopo de serviços e a dedicação estimada, a ser definida em comum acordo. Descrição da Empresa AdvSpace é o último software jurídico que um escritório jurídico brasileiro utilizará em sua existência. Com o uso por dezenas de escritórios ao redor do Brasil, o AdvSpace integra gestão, atendimento e automação com Inteligência Artificial, aumentando a produtividade em escala. Esta é uma oportunidade para participar da história de um produto digital em crescimento. Missão da Prestação de Serviços Produzir soluções em forma de software para o AdvSpace, atuando na evolução contínua do produto, seja na melhoria de funcionalidades existentes, seja na construção de novas soluções, com foco em qualidade técnica, prazos e alinhamento com os objetivos do sistema. Principais Atividades / Entregas Desenvolver código para o AdvSpace conforme processos e padrões de qualidade acordados. Participar de reuniões de alinhamento técnico e de planejamento, quando previamente agendadas. Participar de encontros de atualização técnica e de produto que sejam relevantes para a boa execução dos serviços. Sugerir melhorias em produtos e/ou processos existentes relacionados ao AdvSpace. Reportar as entregas realizadas e em andamento, conforme rotinas de acompanhamento combinadas. Documentar tecnicamente as implementações realizadas, quando necessário para manutenção futura. Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills) Algoritmo e Programação. Lógica-Matemática. Inteligência Artificial. HTML 5. React. Python. Typescript. Serverless. PostgreSQL. Git. RESTful API. CI/CD. Clean Code. Interpretação de texto. Inglês avançado (boa leitura e escrita). Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills) Transparência. Comprometimento. Comunicação. Pensamento crítico. Idoneidade. Autocontrole. Formação e Experiência Formação mínima: Estudante de Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência desejável: Não é necessária experiência profissional prévia;
experiência em projetosacadêmicos ou pessoais será considerada. Certificações / cursos complementares: Certificações e cursos relacionados às tecnologias e competências indicadas na vaga serão considerados diferenciais. Indicadores de Resultado Cumprimento de prazos de entrega. Qualidade técnica das entregas (baixa taxa de retrabalho). Aderência aos requisitos funcionais e técnicos definidos. Evolução contínua na capacidade de contribuição para o produto. Relacionamentos Internos e Externos Relacionamentos internos: Ponto de contato técnico, integrantes da equipe de tecnologia, áreas operacional, marketing e vendas, quando necessário para execução das entregas. Relacionamentos externos: Parceiros de integração do AdvSpace, quando houver necessidade técnica de alinhamento. Ferramentas e Tecnologias Utilizadas Supabase. Vercel. Windsurf. Lovable. GitHub. Sistema da empresa. Linear. Google Workspace. Perfil Ideal do Profissional Profissional planejador e/ou analítico, com interesse genuíno em atuar em produto digital, capacidade de resolver problemas de forma estruturada, abertura a feedbacks e disposição para aprender continuamente. Organização do trabalho: Não há controle formal de jornada. O(a) profissional organiza seus próprios horários, desde que cumpra as entregas e prazos combinados. A dedicação semanal será alinhada previamente, de acordo com o volume de demandas. Reuniões de alinhamento e planejamento ocorrerão, em regra, em horário comercial (entre 9h e 18h, de segunda a sexta-feira). Exclusividade: Não há exigência de exclusividade, sendo facultado ao(à) profissional prestar serviços a outros contratantes, desde que não haja conflito direto com empresas que ofereçam soluções concorrentes ao AdvSpace. Para participar do processo seletivo, favor acesse o seguinte link: A vaga está aberta enquanto o formulário desse link estiver ativo. Caso você seja selecionado, receberá um e-mail de Favor atente-se à sua caixa de SPAM até o dia 31/12/2025, que é quando iremos encerrar o processo seletivo. Observações: Em caso de dúvidas, mande e-mail para Por gentileza não mande WhatsApp ou ligue. O candidato que não seguir essa regra será desclassificado.

title: Analista De Serviços Jr
description:
Atuando desde 1939, a Mercury Marine se consolidou como destaque global na fabricação de motores de popa e soluções para navegação. Com presença sólida no Brasil, atuamos com foco em inovação, confiabilidade, qualidade e alto desempenho, oferecendo produtos e serviços que atendem aos mais altos padrões do mercado náutico visando a satisfação máxima de nossos clientes e usuários. A operação brasileira integra a Brunswick Corporation, um dos maiores grupos do setor marítimo mundial, e combina tecnologia de ponta com compromisso com a excelência e sustentabilidade. Buscamos um(a) ANALISTA SERVIÇOS JR para atuar junto ao time de serviços e garantias em nosso escritório no Rio de Janeiro, contribuindo com a evolução dos processos de pós vendas e fortalecimento do relacionamento com nossos clientes. Por favor, leia atentamente a descrição da vaga e candidate-se SOMENTE caso você atenda os pré-requisitos. Realizar processos de garantia e campanhas de serviço, incluindo controle de documentação, análise e aprovação/rejeição de solicitações, faturamento, pagamento mensal de mão de obra aos concessionários, acompanhamento de peças pendentes e reporte de desvios ou conflitos ao gestor responsável. Prestar suporte técnico-administrativo a concessionários por meio de telefone e treinamentos on-line, orientando sobre políticas de garantia, uso do portal e resolução de demandas relacionadas a clientes, estaleiros e demais partes envolvidas. Manter arquivos, sistemas de registros e materiais técnicos atualizados conforme políticas e procedimentos, garantindo rastreabilidade dos processos e suporte a auditorias internas e externas. Além disso, acompanhar processos de tradução, atualização e distribuição de literaturas técnicas de serviço. Coletar e analisar dados, preparar relatórios estatísticos, monitorar a integração diária de informações entre sistemas (portal e AX) e garantir a acuracidade dos registros, incluindo o cadastro de novos motores. title: Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions
description:
Americas Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office‑based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and.>

The company is founder‑led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions in various locations to drive partnerships for licensing and embedding Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro into software and SaaS solutions.

Canonical supports ISV customers and alliances in building on Ubuntu and Ubuntu Pro, which helps them deliver fast, reliable, secure, compliant and consistent solutions.

We offer the world's most extensive base of open source software, backed by comprehensive SLA support, FIPS‑certified cryptographic compliance, and security commitments that meet HIPAA and FedRAMP standards. We are the top‑rated operating system for developers. Partnering with every major public cloud provider, we ensure Ubuntu is optimized and seamlessly integrated with their unique services, making it easier for ISVs to deploy solutions confidently across multi‑cloud environments. Additionally, we collaborate with leading server manufacturers, IoT providers, and silicon vendors to enable, optimize, and certify Ubuntu on their hardware. This makes Ubuntu an exceptional choice for ISVs selling physical appliances or traditional software solutions.

The world's biggest brands in AI build on these Ubuntu Pro capabilities to ensure they stay focused on their product proposition rather than maintenance or compliance.

Location

Multiple openings in the Americas and in E time zones.

Role Overview

The Sales Director, ISV Embedded Solutions will collaborate with Product, Alliances, Sales, Business Development, and Marketing colleagues to prospect into ISV accounts, introduce our offerings, and help partners or potential customers develop their products to best leverage our portfolio. The successful candidate will:

  • Drive embedded support and licensing sales with ISVs to exceed quarterly and annual booking targets.
  • Lead customer and partner relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales, customer success and support lifecycle.
  • Deepen understanding and engagement with the open source ecosystem.
  • Identify and develop partnerships that support Canonical's strategic ambitions.
  • Collaborate with product management to ensure fitness and enhancement of our platforms and solutions for ISVs.
  • Negotiate contracts with new and existing ISV partners and customers.
  • Shape our content and messaging for ISV partners and customers.

What We Are Looking For

  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about an alternative chosen path.
  • Ability to establish strategic relationships with large organisations at all levels.
  • A passion for technology and extensive experience with the software and SaaS industry, Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred), the open source ecosystem, cloud models, and container service offerings.
  • Experience with lead generation and business development in the software sector.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability.
  • Outstanding business English writing and presentation skills.
  • A personal drive to meet commitments and a track record of delivering beyond expectations.
  • A commitment to leadership, skills development and mentorship.
  • An appreciation of diversity and effectiveness in a multicultural, multi‑national organisation.
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long.

What We Offer

  • Distributed work environment with twice‑yearly team sprints in person.
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.
  • Annual compensation review.
  • Recognition rewards.
  • Annual holiday leave.
  • Maternity and paternity leave.
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues.
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long‑haul company events.

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open‑source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background creates a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Additional Information

Employment type: Full‑time

Job function: Sales and Business Development

Industries: Software Development

Senior Legal Counsel (Chemicals and Retail) - Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Join to apply for the Senior Legal Counsel (Chemicals and Retail) - Relocate to Saudi Arabia role at ARAMCO .

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world and a top global company by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced attorney to join the Chemicals & Retail Legal Practice of the Downstream Law Department within the Aramco Law Organization.

The Practice provides legal support to many downstream entities, primarily from a shareholder and governance perspective, with a focus on general corporate and commercial contracts.

As Counsel, your primary role is to provide legal advice to Saudi Aramco and its subsidiaries, particularly in the area of commercial agreements for the supply and offtake of Saudi Aramco’s wide array of products, including long‑term crude and product sales/placements, crude importation, long‑term refined product/chemical offtakes, processing/netting agreements, tolling arrangements and international hydrocarbon trading.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the corporate secretary for one or more entities, organizing and managing board meetings, and advising as to board authority and corporate governance matters.
  • Advise as to shareholder issues and manage the interface between the entity, the parent, and other affiliates.
  • Work closely with internal Saudi Aramco Downstream clients and support their substantial and complex contracting and purchasing functions.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, O&M agreements, service agreements, and other commercial contracts and related agreements, including complex products supply and offtake agreements.
  • Advise on internal policies, review and resolve claims, and provide training to company personnel on a variety of legal matters.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Law degree minimum; Master or Juris degree preferred.
  • Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident.
  • A minimum of 7 years progressive experience gained in a sophisticated law firm or corporation. A mix of private practice and in‑house experience would be preferred.
  • Relevant commercial contracts and general corporate experience, particularly in the downstream chemicals and retail sectors.
  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
  • Experience providing concise and clear support to clients and leadership, and mentorship experience.

description:
Join to apply for the Chief Audit Officer role at Inside Higher Ed

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission.

At Howard University, we prioritize well‑being and professional growth.

Here Is What We Offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work‑Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Howard University is seeking a Chief Audit Officer (CAO) who serves as the institution’s senior audit executive, leading the internal audit function with authority and independence to provide objective assurance and advisory services across all university operations. The CAO plays a critical role in protecting institutional assets, enhancing operational effectiveness, and supporting the achievement of strategic objectives through systematic evaluation and improvement of risk management, internal controls, and governance processes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Audit Execution

  • Develop and annually update a comprehensive, risk‑based internal audit plan aligned with the university’s strategic priorities, emerging risks, and compliance requirements
  • Present the annual audit plan to the Audit Committee for review and approval, adapting priorities dynamically in response to changing institutional needs
  • Direct and oversee all internal audit engagements, including financial, operational, compliance, information technology, and investigative audits
  • Ensure audit work is performed in accordance with the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing (IIA Standards)
  • Implement and maintain a quality assurance and improvement program, including periodic external assessments
  • Coordinate audit activities with external auditors and regulatory agencies to maximize coverage and minimize redundancy

Reporting & Communication

  • Prepare and present comprehensive audit reports to the President, senior leadership, and Audit Committee, including findings, risk ratings, and actionable recommendations
  • Communicate significant risk exposures, control deficiencies, and governance concerns to the Audit Committee in a timely and transparent manner
  • Provide quarterly status reports on audit plan progress, emerging risks, follow‑up on prior recommendations, and resource utilization
  • Meet privately with the Audit Committee without management present to discuss sensitive matters
  • Review audit workpapers, findings, and reports to ensure quality, accuracy, and appropriate support for conclusions

Risk Management & Advisory Services

  • Conduct ongoing enterprise risk assessments in collaboration with senior leadership to identify and prioritize audit areas
  • Monitor the institutional risk environment, including emerging risks related to technology, cybersecurity, research integrity, Title IX, athletics, sponsored programs, and student services
  • Provide advisory services and consultation on new systems, processes, policies, and strategic initiatives from a risk and control perspective
  • Track regulatory and legal developments affecting higher education, including federal and state requirements, accreditation standards, and grant compliance
  • Facilitate training and awareness programs on internal controls, fraud prevention, ethics, and risk management

Investigations & Special Projects

  • Lead or oversee investigations into allegations of fraud, financial irregularities, policy violations, or misconduct with appropriate confidentiality and due process
  • Coordinate with Human Resources, General Counsel, and law enforcement as appropriate during investigations
  • Conduct special projects and ad hoc reviews at the request of the Audit Committee, President, or senior leadership

Independence & Professional Standards

  • Maintain organizational independence and individual objectivity in all audit activities, free from interference in determining scope, performing work, and communicating results
  • Uphold the IIA Code of Ethics and maintain professional skepticism in all engagements
  • Ensure the internal audit function has unrestricted access to records, personnel, and physical properties relevant to audit activities
  • Avoid conflicts of interest and recuse from audits where independence may be compromised

Team Leadership & External Coordination

  • Recruit, supervise, mentor, and evaluate internal audit staff, fostering professional development and maintaining a high‑performing team
  • Promote continuing professional education and certification for audit staff
  • Manage the internal audit budget and allocate resources effectively to achieve audit plan objectives
  • Serve as the primary liaison with external auditors for financial statement audits, federal compliance audits (Single Audit), and NCAA agreed‑upon procedures
  • Manage relationships with external firms engaged for specialized audits or consulting services

Qualifications

Education

  • Required: Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, business administration, or related field
  • Preferred: Master's degree in accounting, business administration (MBA), public administration (MPA), or related discipline

Certifications

  • Required: At least one of the following professional certifications:
    • Certified Internal Auditor (CIA)
    • Certified Public Accountant (CPA)
    • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA)
  • Preferred: Multiple relevant certifications demonstrating breadth of expertise

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years of progressive internal audit experience, with at least 5 years in a leadership or management role
  • Demonstrated experience in higher education, public sector, nonprofit, or similarly complex organizational environments strongly preferred
  • Proven track record of developing and executing risk‑based audit plans and managing audit engagements from planning through reporting
  • Experience presenting audit findings and recommendations to audit committees or boards of directors

Knowledge & Skills

  • Comprehensive understanding of the International Standards for the Professional Practice of Internal Auditing and the COSO Internal Control Framework
  • Strong knowledge of governance, enterprise risk management, and compliance frameworks (e.g., COSO ERM, ISO 31000)
  • Familiarity with higher education regulations including Title IV financial aid, OMB Uniform Guidance, research compliance, NCAA rules, and FERPA
  • Proficiency in data analytics tools and audit management software
  • Understanding of information technology controls, cybersecurity risks, and IT audit methodologies
  • Knowledge of fraud detection and prevention techniques

Competencies

  • Leadership: Ability to lead and inspire a professional team, influence organizational change, and navigate complex institutional environments
  • Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with ability to present complex information clearly to diverse audiences
  • Analytical Thinking: Strong critical thinking, problem‑solving, and analytical skills with attention to detail
  • Relationship Building: Diplomatic and collaborative approach, with ability to build trust and credibility across all organizational levels
  • Integrity: Unwavering commitment to ethical conduct, objectivity, and professional standards
  • Judgment: Sound decision‑making ability and professional skepticism, balanced with pragmatism and business acumen
  • Adaptability: Flexibility to manage changing priorities, emerging risks, and resource constraints in a dynamic environment

Data Scientist

One year in Norway, a career in Brazil—grow with us across borders

calendar_today

About Solution Seeker

Solution Seeker - with headquarters in Norway and a subsidiary in Brazil - is a scaleup building software and AI for industrial production optimization, turning data into value and strategic insight for our users.

Our software streams live sensor data from production facilities worldwide, processed in an event-driven, distributed system using patented algorithms to identify stable periods and select the most valuable data points for our machine learning models.

On top of this, we develop applications that help customers visualize and contextualize their data with our predictions and analyses, enabling them to make better production decisions. Beyond client work, we dedicate significant time and resources to cutting-edge machine learning research, including generative and probabilistic modeling, hybrid modeling (combining physics and ML), data-driven production optimization, and closed-loop identification.

As a Data Scientist, you will work hands-on with our data and play a key role in addressing some of the most important technical and strategic challenges we face. Your tasks may include:

  • Analyzing large volumes of production data to solve real customer challenges
  • Developing and optimizing our machine learning models
  • Designing and building applications based on customer needs
  • Preparing and delivering insightful presentations internally and externally
  • Contributing to strategic initiatives such as go-to-market plans, positioning, and delivery models

You’ll develop both technical and business expertise in a growing scaleup, giving you a strong foundation for future growth, whether you aim to specialize technically, move into business roles, or step into leadership.

About you

In addition to being technically skilled, you are naturally curious and never back down from a challenge. You are generous and accountable, always seeking to include others rather than exclude them. Your playful nature and willingness to contribute to the work environment make you a valuable team member because you know that happy developers mean happy customers.

You thrive in a young, international, fast-paced environment where your passion for continuous learning and innovation drives your success. Join us and be part of a team that embraces curiosity, warmth, playfulness, and punchiness as we create groundbreaking solutions and strengthen our position as world-leading experts in our field

Requirements

  • Fluency in English and Portuguese , both written and spoken (English will be your main working language)
  • Willingness to live 12 months in Oslo, Norway (from Feb 2026) and return to Rio to join the Brazilian team once your initial rotation is over.
  • Interest in digitalization, machine learning, and AI
  • Basic understanding of programming and strong logical reasoning skills
  • Ability to take initiative and deliver results
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Being Brazilian or possessing a valid work permit to work in Brazil (once your rotation in Oslo is over)
  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related field
  • Our tech stack is large and we do not expect you to know all of it, but any familiarity would be greatly appreciated skills
  • Familiarity with Python
  • Experience working with large datasets
  • Experience/knowledge of Plotly Dash
  • Experience studying or working abroad
  • Experience with simulation, optimization, and modeling
  • Master’s degree in engineering or a related field

What we offer

To give you the best possible start before joining our Rio de Janeiro team, you’ll spend your first year with us at our headquarters in Oslo, where you’ll get a full onboarding into the company, our people, and our way of working. Job description

Somos uma empresa 100% digital, com tecnologia desenvolvida localmente e líder no mercado de compra e venda online. Nos tornamos a marca que melhor representa a economia circular no país.

Hoje contamos com dois escritórios nas cidades de Rio de Janeiro e São Paulo. Nosso modelo de trabalho flexível oferece autonomia e liberdade para que nossas pessoas elaborem seus padrões e rotinas com disciplina e protagonismo na conexão com negócio, as prioridades e o propósito da empresa.

Construir um ambiente diverso, inclusivo e comprometido com a equidade faz parte do nosso DNA. Entendemos que diversidade, equidade e inclusão são essenciais para criarmos um ambiente seguro com entregas inovadoras e eficientes para nossas pessoas e sociedade.

Main responsibilities

Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por dados e gostaria de aplicar seus conhecimentos para criar modelos de predição focados em performance de negócios, essa vaga é para você!

Como Data Scientist Specialist II, você irá atuar junto com um time multidisciplinar e apoio de áreas especializadas em Ciência de Dados, transformando dados em valor e contribuindo para os planejamentos junto ao time de negócio. Será responsável por desenvolver modelos, análises e experimentos de pricing que apoiem decisões estratégicas de precificação, otimizem receita e impulsionem o crescimento do negócio.

  • Explorar e analisar grandes volumes de dados para gerar insights acionáveis;
  • Construir, treinar e validar modelos estatísticos e de machine learning voltados para performance de negócios;
  • Colaborar com times de Produto, Engenharia e Negócios para entender problemas, levantar hipóteses e propor soluções baseadas em dados;
  • Comunicar resultados de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Desenvolver pipelines de dados e automações para garantir a escalabilidade das soluções;
  • Monitorar a performance dos modelos em produção e propor melhorias contínuas;
  • Aplicar boas práticas de versionamento, reprodutibilidade e governança de modelos;
  • Participar ativamente de cerimônias ágeis e contribuir com a evolução das práticas de ciência de dados na empresa.

Requirements and skills

E o que você precisa ter?

  • Condução em análises exploratórias e estudos de impacto para embasar decisões estratégicas de pricing.
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL e Python;
  • Experiência em conduzir análises quantitativas robustas e consistentes, desde a definição do problema até a apresentação dos resultados;
  • Habilidade para criar e apresentar storytelling de dados, traduzindo insights técnicos em linguagem acessível para diferentes públicos;
  • Capacidade de definir problemas de negócio claros e propor soluções baseadas em dados que gerem impacto real;
  • Apoiar experimentos A/B e modelos de simulação para testar novas políticas de preço e medir impacto financeiro.
  • Escrita de código em nível de criação de protótipos, sem depender de engenheiros de software.

Desejável:

  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de software

Additional information

Mais sobre o Grupo OLX:

No Brasil desde 2010, o Grupo OLX tem como propósito empoderar as pessoas para que alcancem seus sonhos, reinventando o modelo de consumo. Com a aquisição do Grupo ZAP, concluída em outubro de 2020, a companhia opera a OLX, plataforma horizontal com posição de liderança nas categorias de automóveis, bens de consumo usados e imóveis; e duas plataformas líderes do mercado imobiliário, ZAP e Viva Real.

Job description

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Planejar, organizar, monitorar e avaliar as atividades técnicas e administrativas assistenciais das unidades de enfermagem. Overview

We are seeking an Oil Reservoir Management Engineer with extensive experience in Oil Reservoir Management to join our Exploration and Petroleum Engineering Center in Dhahran. Our Center provides expert advice and guidance on all aspects of oil reservoir management, including designing, participating in and implementing best‑in‑class reservoir management programs. This position is embedded within the Petroleum Engineering business and as a senior technical specialist, you will engage with leaders and experts from across the upstream business.

Your primary role is to manage some of the world’s largest onshore and offshore oil fields, conduct pioneering research, introduce new technologies and provide specialized engineering services as part of the customized reservoir management practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide guidance and oversight on best-in-class reservoir management tenets, practices and state of the art technologies for all Saudi Aramco hydrocarbon assets.
  • Formulate reservoir development, data acquisition, strategic surveillance and monitoring master-plans to ensure optimal development and depletion strategies.
  • Utilize reservoir management standards and guidelines to enhance both net present value and hydrocarbon recovery.
  • Lead, design and participate in integrated field reviews and field development plans.
  • Prepare reservoir engineering input into drilling and work-over proposals and programs.
  • Recommend advanced completion techniques for horizontal and multi-lateral wells.
  • Lead and participate in reservoir engineering studies that include reservoir stimulation modeling of various International Offshore Rule (IOR) processes for improvement of ultimate recovery.
  • Participate in technical societies and technical groups.

Qualifications

  • Hold a Bachelor degree in Petroleum Engineering or related discipline. A Master degree or PhD is desirable, but not required.
  • Have a minimum of 10 years related experience including at least 7 years specializing in oil reservoir management. A training history of appropriate specialized courses and seminars is expected. Technical publications are valued but in‑depth practical experience is paramount.
  • Must have full professional proficiency in English required to interact and communicate clearly with specialists in geology, core and fluid analysis, petrophysics, simulation, drilling, completion, production and facilities.
  • Must have working knowledge of open‑hole and cased‑hole logs, geological modeling, simulation, completion and production procedures and technologies.
  • Technical knowledge and expertise are required in formation evaluation, geological modeling, simulation, reservoir appraisal and field development planning, completion, production/injection procedures, strategy technologies, water flooding, reservoir surveillance, SCAL, PVT, geochemical analysis and fluid compatibility. Additionally, expertise in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and data analytics are desirable but not required.
  • Must have history of using modern reservoir management practices for oil reservoirs.

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by the challenging and rewarding professional, technical and industrial opportunities we offer, and are remunerated accordingly. At Aramco, our people work on truly world‑scale projects, supported by investment in capital and technology that is second to none. Head of Brand, Marketing and Promotion

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • This person and department will be responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property. This includes, but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position(s)
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus
  • Experience working in a global or international environment
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient
  • Financial and budget management
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

Como é Ser Uma Pessoa Software Engineer Go Senior:

Procuramos uma pessoa desenvolvedora apaixonada por desafios, tecnologia e conhecimento. Essa pessoa, junto ao time, será responsável por:

  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e manutenção de novas funcionalidades;
  • Ter responsabilidade para desenvolver em sistemas de importância crítica para a companhia;
  • Monitorar o desempenho e a aplicação das alterações dos sistemas;
  • Documentar as mudanças realizadas;

  • Saiba realizar inspeções no código e na documentação;
  • Implemente testes automatizados;

  • Tenha conhecimento de Bancos de dados relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL)
  • Tenha conhecimento em arquitetura de microsserviços;

Além das vagas afirmativas, todas as vagas Stone também são destinadas a pessoas com deficiência.

Plano de Saúde e Odontológico

Hospital Digital, da Vitta: contamos com uma equipe médica multidisciplinar, terapeutas e um time de saúde disponível 24 horas por dia 7 dias por semana de forma rápida e prática

  2. Entrevistas com o time de People: Este é o momento de nos conhecermos! Você terá um papo inicial com nosso time de recrutamento, com o objetivo de conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio que está sendo proposto.

  4. Check de Cultura: Nossa cultura é muito importante e está sempre presente no dia a dia! Aqui, você terá um papo com uma das nossas pessoas guardiões da cultura, com o objetivo de nos conhecer e garantir que nossas crenças, nosso jeito de pensar e nossa visão de futuro estão alinhadas com o que você acredita e busca vivenciar.
  5. Feedback: Uma de nossas forças é a franqueza. Por isso, independente do resultado, iremos compartilhá-lo com você e alinhar os próximos passos.

Aqui na Stone Co., valorizamos e procuramos as melhores pessoas para nos ajudar a melhorar a vida das pessoas empreendedoras do Brasil. Nosso sonho é do tamanho do universo e, se você se identifica com o nosso propósito, venha construí-lo com a gente!

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
Design Director, UI/UX & Brand

Join to apply for the Design Director, UI/UX & Brand role at Darkroom

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter , a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos) . Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

This role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior‑level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e‑commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e‑commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English. Open to candidates in the following locations: Brazil, Mexico, Portugal, and Spain.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.
  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.
  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.
  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.
  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.
  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.
  • Ensure high‑quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.
  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e-commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.
  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.
  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.
  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.
  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.
  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.
  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.
  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.
  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in‑office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
Senior Legal Counsel - Relocate to Saudi Arabia

Join to apply for the Senior Legal Counsel - Relocate to Saudi Arabia role at Aramco

Candidate must relocate to Saudi Arabia.

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generational spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking an experienced attorney (Counsel) to join the Venture Capital Transactions Legal Practice in the Project Development & Finance Law Department of the Saudi Aramco Law Organization.

The Joint Venture Development Legal Practice within the Law Organization is responsible for, among other matters, advising on, negotiating, and documenting Saudi Aramco’s VC transactions and providing legal support to assist with managing Saudi Aramco’s VC portfolio.

As a Senior Counsel, your primary role is to lead the legal activities with respect to the development and implementation of minority VC investments, including the structuring, negotiation, and documentation of such transactions, and providing post-closing legal support to assist with managing the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the legal activities with respect to the negotiation and execution of financing transactions in all contexts. Including for parent company bank debt, joint venture project financings, and/or capital markets issuances, among others, including the structuring, negotiation, and documentation of such transactions.
  • Advise Management and internal clients with respect to Saudi Aramco’s legal rights and obligations, agreements, and common statutory or similar requirements in connection with financing transactions.
  • Assist Law Management and other attorneys in identifying and examining the law and facts pertinent to legal problems.
  • Liaise and work with outside counsel to negotiate and document transactions.

Qualifications

  • A Juris Doctorate degree or equivalent.
  • Current admission to general practice before the highest court of the state or country of which you are a citizen or resident.
  • A minimum 7 years of experience of Project VC experience.
  • Experience comprised of a combination of law firm and in-house experience in a corporation handling VC transactions.
  • Demonstrable experience working directly with the clients from transaction inception to completion of VC transactions.
  • Hands‑on experience with structuring, drafting, negotiating, and leading transactions in a first or second chair capacity.
  • Experience with Venture Capital principles.
  • Experience in the oil and gas, refining, chemicals, power or other energy-related industries (including renewable energy and new energies)

Work Location: Within Saudi Arabia – To be specified in Job offer

Work Schedule: Full Time – To be specified in Job offer

  • Mid‑Senior level

description:
Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”), which for the first time ever is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Position Overview

The Head of Brand & Marketing at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil (TM), will be tasked to guide and implement brand and marketing plans, campaigns and activations in line with the marketing & communication strategy. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as an extension to, and be part of the global MBBI (Marketing, Brand, Business Intelligence) team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines, for being a key representative to all Brand, Marketing and Promotion Tournament matters.
  • Responsible for all promotional aspects including any communications designed and required to support the commercial and marketing objectives of the tournament.
  • Be the main liaison for Host Country and Host City representatives, tournament executive leadership representing the MBBI team.
  • Lead the local, regional and national delivery of various marketing campaigns and initiatives related to, and beyond identified tournament milestones.
  • Lead a team of brand & marketing professionals on the ground, and ensure seamless cooperation, collaboration and integration with all relevant functional areas at FWWC27 LTDA and FIFA’s head office in Zurich, as well as any other functional areas such as legal, finance, etc.
  • Identify and communicate opportunities to create dedicated local, regional or national promotional activities that support the objectives of the tournament, the marketing strategy, or any relevant stakeholders such as commercial partners, media partners, host cities, and others.
  • Identify and drive commercial value through the marketing of the tournament’s brand assets and intellectual property, including but not limited to mascots, licensing & retail, the FIFA Fan Festival, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Trophy Tour, official music tracks/album/sonic identities, and other.
  • Contribute to, and drive implementation of ticketing & hospitality go-to-market strategy and activations plans.
  • Establish and maintain strong and impactful relationships with relevant partners, celebrities, influencers, key event organizers, agencies, etc.
  • Manage and maintain budget and liaise with the relevant colleagues in Zurich in all matters budget and spend.
  • Oversee the correct implementation and utilization of all in-market tournament brand asset implementations and applications including, but not limited to, event and stadium dressing, experiential marketing applications, retail branding, and any other use of the brand assets by FIFA’s internal and external stakeholders.
  • Manage procurement and legal processes (in compliance with FWWC27 LTDA policies and guidelines) as it relates to the tendering and contracting of local, regional or national suppliers, service providers, agencies, and other.
  • Manage and deliver all necessary reporting measures related to the tournament.
  • Drive and manage effective communications between the relevant functional areas and, in particular with the MBBI team in Zurich.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or similar higher education in marketing, or a marketing related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years’ experience in a relevant leadership position.
  • Proven experience delivering major brand & marketing plans.
  • Experience in the sports and/or entertainment industry is a major plus.
  • Experience working in a global or international environment.
  • Proven track record in managing a team in a matrix or similar structure.
  • Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills and the ability to manage up, down and sideways.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills.
  • Profound knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture.
  • Ability to work to deadlines and stress resilient.
  • Financial and budget management.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Additional Information

  • Employment type: Contract
  • Job function: Marketing and Sales

This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies
  • Ownership Mentality: You own your models post-deployment and continuously improve them
  • Execution-Oriented: You deliver production-grade systems quickly without sacrificing rigor
  • Curious & Innovative: You stay on top of ML advances and apply them to personalization

Nice‑to‑Haves

Example Projects You Might Own

  • Build a privacy‑aware custom plugin that injects ad placements conditionally based on consent signals (TCF/US Privacy) and viewability

A primeira coisa que você precisa saber é que aqui você não vai cair na rotina. A Radix desenvolve soluções para empresas de diferentes setores e indústrias. Cada projeto tem suas tecnologias, soluções e prazos e você terá oportunidade de atuar e experimentar diferentes desafios.

Além da nossa atuação pelo Brasil, com escritório no Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo e Belo Horizonte, temos também filiais nos Estados Unidos, fazendo com que a Radix se consolide cada vez mais como uma empresa global .

Quer fazer parte dessa história e transformar ideias e sonhos em realidade?

Como Profissional de Engenharia de Prompt você vai:

  • Desenvolver, estruturar e aprimorar prompts aplicados ao Atlas AI da Cognite, garantindo assertividade, consistência e alinhamento aos objetivos do projeto.
  • Converter necessidades de negócio e requisitos técnicos da área de petróleo e gás em instruções claras e eficazes para modelos de linguagem.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com equipes de engenharia de dados, especialistas de domínio e stakeholders do cliente para criar fluxos conversacionais produtivos.
  • Monitorar, avaliar e ajustar continuamente a qualidade das respostas geradas, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e mitigação de inconsistências.
  • Elaborar diretrizes internas, materiais de referência e documentação de melhores práticas para padronização do uso da IA no ambiente do cliente.
  • Contribuir ativamente com feedback estruturado para evolução das funcionalidades relacionadas ao uso de IA na plataforma Cognite.

Para essa vaga, você deve ter:

  • Experiência comprovada em engenharia de prompt, NLP ou utilização de modelos de linguagem em contexto corporativo.
  • Capacidade de interpretar e traduzir conceitos técnicos de geologia, perfuração, completação, produção ou áreas correlatas para instruções orientadas à IA.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de dados, análise de dados ou operação de plataformas de dados industriais.
  • Habilidade de comunicação escrita e verbal clara, com capacidade de documentação estruturada.
  • Raciocínio crítico para validação de resultados e tomada de decisão baseada em qualidade e aderência ao contexto operacional.
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente para participação em discussões técnicas, revisão de materiais e alinhamentos com stakeholders internacionais.

É um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência com Cognite Data Fusion (CDF), Atlas AI ou outras soluções de dados industriais.
  • Vivência prévia no setor de óleo e gás ou familiaridade com processos de E&P.
  • Conhecimento em Python ou outra linguagem utilizada para manipulação e análise de dados.
  • Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital em ambientes industriais ou energéticos.

Benefícios:

  • Assistência Médica Nacional (para o titular e dependentes, com quarto privativo)
  • Assistência odontológica nacional (para o titular e dependentes)
  • Vale refeição / alimentação flexível
  • Auxílio home office
  • Day off (no mês do aniversário)
  • Wellhub (antigo Gympass)
  • Licença Maternidade (6 meses) e Paternidade (20 dias) estendidas
  • Auxílio creche para filhos de até 3 anos (por filho)
  • Apoio em saúde mental com a Wellz
  • Clube de Vantagens com descontos em diversos parceiros
  • Convênio com instituições de ensino e cursos de idioma
  • Desenvolvimento Profissional (Universidade Corporativa)
  • Parceria com empresa de coworkings no Brasil
  • Programa de Qualidade de Vida e Bem-Estar
  • Médico consultor para acompanhamento de radixers
  • Planos de incentivos

A Radix está sempre no topo das Melhores Empresas para se trabalhar porque:

  • Temos profissionais comprometidos, dedicados, curiosos e inovadores.
  • O espírito de equipe é a nossa maior força. Trabalhamos de forma cooperativa e sabemos que estamos juntos, remando na mesma direção.
  • Temos um ambiente diverso, que valoriza equidade e inclusão.
  • Nossa jornada de trabalho é flexível e em quase todos os projetos é possível trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil.
  • Valorizamos o bem-estar e o cuidado com as nossas pessoas, com programas de apoio à saúde mental, psiquiatra e médico consultor disponíveis.

Curtiu?

Há 15 anos entre as melhores empresas para trabalhar no Rio, no Brasil e em Tecnologia... Prazer, Radix.

Atuamos na transformação digital de clientes em diversos segmentos, implementamos soluções tornam os processos mais eficientes e, através de um time altamente especializado e multidisciplinar. Temos atuação global, com projetos em mais de 30 países, para empresas de diferentes tamanhos e setores. Geramos impactos reais, nos negócios e na trajetória das pessoas que passam por aqui.

Rio de Janeiro/RJ
Código de referência: CE RJ24
Vaga Permanente

Segmento: Educação Infantil e Ensino Fundamental I

DESCRIÇÃO SINTÉTICA DO CARGO:

  • Responsabilizar-se, em parceria com as Coordenações Pedagógicas de Segmento, pelo planejamento e implantação da proposta pedagógica;
  • Realizar a gestão da sua unidade de negócio (segmento) garantindo a sustentabilidade e os resultados, considerando a excelência acadêmica;
  • Acompanhar os processos de ensino e de aprendizagem em parceria com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento dos alunos nos níveis cognitivo, psicosexual, afetivo e social;
  • Promover a parceria Escola/Família.

ATRIBUIÇÕES

1.Acompanhar os processos de ensino e de aprendizagem em parceria com a equipe pedagógica, com foco nos resultados garantindo a implementação da proposta pedagógica:

1.1 – Implementa, junto com a equipe pedagógica, o planejamento anual em conformidade com o projeto pedagógico do colégio.
1.2 – Participa, junto ao Serviço de Orientação Religiosa, do planejamento dos dias de formação e convivência.

1.3 – Colabora com informações relevantes no processo de avaliação de professores, em parceria com as CPS’s , a partir do acompanhamento realizado aos estudantes.
1.4 – Promove estudos que propiciem a qualificação e atuação dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
1.5 – Responsabiliza-se pelo processo de enturmação de estudantes.

1.6 – Mantém parceria constante com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento quanto ao processo de intervenção e acompanhamento dos estudantes junto aos professores.
1.7 – Elaborar em parceria com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento os processos de organização dos Conselhos de Classe.

1.8 – Conduz os Conselhos de Classe, orientando as discussões.

1.9 – Cumpre o Plano de Metas estabelecido a partir da Avaliação de Desempenho.

2 – Realizar gestão de processos relacionados ao desenvolvimento da aprendizagem dos estudantes considerando a excelência acadêmica:

2.1. Prioriza no plano operacional da unidade, as atividades específicas de sua função conforme a proposta pedagógica..
2.2. Estabelece foco na condução profissional das suas atividades.
2.3. Monitora o andamento da realização do plano de ação, visando à revisão de estratégias em tempo hábil.

2.4. Realiza análises quantitativas e qualitativas para respaldar as ações de intervenção junto aos alunos e às famílias.
2.5. Implementa ações que propiciem o processo de autorregulação de aprendizagem.
2.6. Orienta os professores para o acompanhamento do desempenho dos estudantes, especialmente aqueles com necessidades educativas especiais.

2.7.Efetiva projetos de formação de liderança e protagonismo juvenil em parceria com a coordenação do SOR.
2.8. Sistematiza processo de autoavaliação dos estudantes.
2.9 .Realiza projetos, junto aos estudantes, a partir de uma visão integradora dos segmentos.

2.10. Registra os processos sob sua responsabilidade.

2.11. Acompanha o desenvolvimento da aquisição das habilidades cognitivas dos estudantes, incentivando-os na construção dos hábitos de estudos.
2.12. Monitora criteriosamente o trabalho dos Auxiliares de Disciplina.
2.13. Zela pelo cumprimento dos códigos de disciplina e ética dentro da escola.

3 – Promover a parceria Escola/Família na condução do processo educacional :

3.1 – Colabora com as Coordenadoras Pedagógicas de Segmento na realização de reuniões com os pais.
3.2 – Inova no atendimento às famílias buscando a fidelização dos estudantes.
3.3 – Estrutura com a equipe pedagógica uma linha de ação para a inclusão dos estudantes com necessidades educativas especiais e suas famílias.

3.4 – Colabora na acolhida e orientação dos estudantes novatos.
3.5 – Encaminha às famílias, por escrito, quaisquer medidas disciplinares adotadas pela unidade em relação ao estudante.

– Conhecimentos na área pedagógica adquiridos em pós graduação lato sensu.
– Conhecimentos na área de neurociências adquiridos em pós graduação lato sensu.

– Conhecimento tecnológico.
– Gestão de projetos.
– Processos relacionados à metacognição e à autorregulação.
– Gestão de conflitos.
